Continue:

Since the sequence is positive,
\[
a_n^2+\sqrt n\,a_n=2n.
\]
Solving the quadratic in \(a_n\):
\[
a_n^2+\sqrt n\,a_n-2n=0
\]
gives the positive root
\[
a_n=\frac{-\sqrt n+\sqrt{n+8n}}2=\frac{-\sqrt n+3\sqrt n}{2}=\sqrt n.
\]
Thus
\[
\sum_{i=1}^{2024}\frac1{a_i}=\sum_{i=1}^{2024}\frac1{\sqrt i}.
\]
Using integral bounds for the decreasing function \(f(x)=1/\sqrt x\),
\[
1+\int_2^{2025}\frac{dx}{\sqrt x}\le S\le 1+\int_1^{2024}\frac{dx}{\sqrt x}.
\]
So
\[
1+2(45-\sqrt2)\le S\le 1+2(\sqrt{2024}-1).
\]
Therefore
\[
91-2\sqrt2\le S\le 2\sqrt{2024}-1.
\]
Since
\[
91-2\sqrt2>88
\]
and
\[
2\sqrt{2024}-1<2\cdot 45-1=89,
\]
we get
\[
88<S<89.
\]
Hence the largest integer not exceeding the sum is
\[
\boxed{88}.
\]
